input.title: Sew Merry & Bright Christmas Bunny MagSafe Case for iPhone & Samsung
input.descriptionHtml:
A plush patchwork bunny, quilted Christmas trees and stitched fabric letters spelling Sew Merry & Bright: a cozy, handmade-look Christmas design on soft cream linen, printed edge to edge on your case.

  • MagSafe Tough: a hard polycarbonate shell over a shock-absorbing TPU insert with built-in magnets for MagSafe chargers, wallets and mounts.
  • Full-wrap print: the design is sublimated into the surface and wraps around the edges, sealed under a scratch-resistant finish.
  • Gloss or Matte: glossy shine or soft-touch matte (Matte for iPhone 13 and newer).

Fabric, quilting, buttons and stitching are printed details, not raised texture. Made to order and printed for your exact phone model. Choose your model and finish above.
